dialogue_texts: The sun feels particularly heavy today, doesn't it?
This is quite a luxury we've been working to get back.
The weight of victory is finally settling in - just a perfect, beautiful afternoon.
You call it 'victory', my Majesty, but you're far from truly achieving it.
Listen to me, My Majesty. There could be one final shard to this incident.
A shard? You imply the root wasn't fully severed. Where is this lingering shadow?
I think the glohm experiment must have started in the Scarlet Devil Mansion.
Vladrouge's estate... how troublesome. If the glohm took root there, Gensokyo's equilibrium would still be at risk.
I cannot allow this to happen again, so please go there if you can.
Very well, if the Empress of Eternity must draw her blinds once more to finish it, so be it.
You must be all tired from that fighting, My Majesty. I can give you a night in the mansion to rest up.
A night in the mansion while Kozankyo awaits my return? You're quite a bold one.
I'm glad you're staying because do you want to witness something spectacular?
We have to wait until the sun sets, which won't be until a few hours.
Patience is a virtue of the immortal. I wonder what could surpass the beauty I just restored.
The sun's disc is almost past the horizon. Wait for it...
F-Fusana? You aren't merely a sweeper of dust, are you?
Night is where my true strength lies. This was the reason my partner and I got close. Our first dance clearly showed we'd be together.
Sometimes, a romantic dance can defy the flow of time. I really wanted to marry Kourin, but he went with Queen Marisa instead... being without a spouse makes me lonely.
Same thing here. When my partner's not present, I feel lonely like a princess in a tower.
Perhaps we're two of a kind - a princess and an empress waiting for a dawn that never arrives.
Rest then, My Majesty. Tomorrow's world will still be there, and everything we've been through today will be nothing more than a bad dream.
May the morning be as clear as the path we've swept.
Congratulations! Good ending! Tomorrow on the agenda is the Scarlet Devil Mansion, where the Extra Stage awaits.
